Rowe Price, Capital International, D1, ICONIQ, GIC, and Coatue. Annualized revenue now >$2B, 85,000 customers (from 70k in June), >$275B annualized purchase volume, up 175% YoY (https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/15/ramp-reaches-60b-valuation-as-it-pushes-deeper-into-ai/).
Launched Glass in early Oct 2026, a workspace that stores and shares an organization's AI automations, prompts, and skills (TechCrunch, same article).
notes: Gunderson describes Dragoneer as 'the lead investor'; TechCrunch says co-led by five firms. No verified X post for the announcement was collected (no status ID found).
